title: Intent
description: Full lifecycle of a single captured intent, from capture to resolution.

text.description: Raw transcribed (or typed) intent text, unedited.

capture_method.description: How the intent entered the system. Capture stays dumb: no analysis here.

reminder_sent_at.description: Set by the Reminder Agent once a check-in fires. Null until then.

follow_up_count.description: How many follow-up check-ins have fired for this intent.

resolution_status.description: Not a boolean by design. See blurt-concept.md's 'resolved needs more than binary yes/no' note. done_adjacent = did something related instead of the literal intent; no_longer_relevant = user decided it didn't matter; abandoned = repeatedly ignored, no repair worked.

category.description: Inferred task category, written by Persona Agent, read by Reminder Agent. Null until inferred.

state.description: Lifecycle position, distinct from resolution_status. Added 0.2.0 per the Notion roadmap's minimal intent state machine (2026-08-10): captured -> dormant -> surfaced -> {resolved | deferred -> surfaced again | stalled | dropped}; stalled repeating N times -> flagged_for_recovery, which feeds Recovery Mode (aggregate, not per-intent). Editable for the first few weeks of real use per that doc — expect renames/merges/splits, not a locked taxonomy yet.

state_updated_at.description: When `state` last changed. Null until the first transition away from the initial capture state.

stall_count.description: How many times this intent has cycled into `stalled`. Crossing a not-yet-tuned threshold moves it to flagged_for_recovery.
